summary_1line: Mortally wounded Jatayu tells Rama Ravana carried Sita south, then dies; Rama mourns deeply and performs funeral rites for the heroic vulture.

image_candidates.scene_text: The giant vulture Jatayu lies bleeding on the forest floor while Rama kneels beside him, listening to his final words.
Jatayu, wings severed and body torn, gasps as blood falls from his beak while he tells Rama that Ravana fled south with Sita.
Rama lights the funeral pyre of the fallen vulture king in the forest, treating him with the honor of a royal funeral.
